title: Reasonable Storage Charge Schedule for Assigned Repair Payments
content:
The daily storage rate of an assigned repair payment under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) follows the company's reasonable storage charge schedule. The schedule is keyed to the garaging state recorded on the Owner Auto Policy term the coverage belongs to.

| Garaging state of the Owner Auto Policy term | Daily storage rate (USD) |
|---|---|
| Florida | 40 |
| Georgia | 35 |
| Texas or Arizona | 30 |
| Any other state (Virginia or Ohio) | 25 |

### Hypothetical illustration

For 3 storage days, the storage comes to:
- 120.00 USD for a vehicle on an owner term garaged in Florida;
- 105.00 USD in Georgia;
- 90.00 USD in Arizona;
- 75.00 USD in Virginia.
